messages:
lera: Quick copy check — error banner when a model upload fails due to incompatible weight format. Need text that explains what's wrong, gives a clear next step, and doesn't sound too technical for product users. Thoughts?

owen (runtime eng): We should call out that the upload failed due to an unsupported format (e.g., Sharded or custom quant formats). Recommend linking to the upload spec and providing the upload log. Avoid deep internals like shard counts.

mira (PM): Yes — users need guidance: how to fix (convert, re-export) or where to download a compatible artifact. Prefer "Fix upload" CTA over generic "Retry".

copybot: Accessibility: CTA labels should be action + object, e.g., "View error details" or "Open upload docs". Provide alt text for any inline icons. :robot_face:

lera: Draft options below — short and long versions.

Option A (short, action-first):
```
Upload failed — unsupported weight format.
Convert or re-export your model to a supported format and try again.
[View upload docs] [Upload logs]
```

Option B (explicit + help):
```
Model upload failed: unsupported weights.
The uploaded file uses a weight format we do not support. See the upload requirements to convert your model or download the upload logs for details.
[Open upload requirements] [Download logs]
```

Option C (friendly + troubleshooting):
```
Upload couldn't be processed
We couldn't process the uploaded weights. Try exporting using the standard ONNX/Torch format or check the logs for specific errors. Need help? Contact support with your upload ID.
[Check logs] [Open upload docs] [Contact support]
```

owen: Prefer B or C. B is concise; C is friendlier but has extra CTAs. Implementation: ensure "Download logs" streams a small file and not break the UI.

mira: Marketing/legal note: avoid promising we can fix files. Remove phrasing like "we'll fix it". Also avoid implying the upload contains secrets. Good to include an upload ID so support can triage.

lera: Revised candidate combining clarity + neutral tone:
```
Model upload failed: unsupported weights
The file you uploaded uses a weight format we do not support. Convert or re-export the model to a supported format, or download the upload logs and share the upload ID with support.
[Open upload requirements] [Download upload logs]
```

copybot: Suggestion: CTA labels "Open upload requirements" -> "View upload requirements" for screen reader flow. Also ensure the upload ID is visually truncated but fully available in the logs.

owen: Small accuracy tweak: replace "weight format" -> "weight file format" to be slightly clearer.

lera: Final proposed banner copy:
```
Model upload failed: unsupported weight file format
The file you uploaded uses a weight file format we do not support. Convert or re-export the model to a supported format, or download the upload logs and share the upload ID with support.
[View upload requirements] [Download upload logs]
```

mira: LGTM. Add a small inline tooltip on the banner: "Supported formats: Torch, ONNX, SlicedCheckpoint v2" (ops will keep this list up to date).

owen: Dev note: include the upload ID in the tooltip and the logs response. Also add an analytics event for the banner CTAs.

copybot: Accessibility checklist: buttons labeled "View upload requirements" and "Download upload logs" are good. Ensure aria-describedby points to the line about sharing the upload ID with support.

sam (Design QA): I'll run accessibility and microcopy checks in staging. If everything looks good I'll push the component to the library.

lera: Thanks all — I'll update Figma and the component docs with the final copy and tooltip. Closing thread unless any last comments.
